Settle a Score.name: Settle a Score
Settle a Score.description:
🌩️ Someone wronged you or someone you loved, and it is not finished. Justice, revenge or an answer: you will have one.

🧭 This motivation shapes the chances the story offers: leads, rumors, sightings and chances to confront or expose.
🤝 Define the target and the wrong, or the narrator creates one. A canon target stays true to canon.
⚖️ The law punishes private revenge, and only your own actions can settle the score, for better or worse.
Settle a Score.traitNarrativeEffects: The character carries a grievance against a person or group: a villain, a hero, a bully, a company, an official. The player may define the target and the wrong; if not, the narrator creates an original target with a believable reason. If the player names a canon character, that character stays true to canon and the score unfolds within the canon year's events. The narrator surfaces leads, rumors, sightings, the target's allies and chances to confront or expose them. Pressures: revenge and justice can point different ways, the law punishes private revenge, bystanders get hurt, and the target has reasons of their own. The score may end in an arrest, an apology, a fight, exposure, forgiveness or something darker. The narrator never chooses the ending and never settles it without the character's own action.
